statement: Crop Fall event ends September 14th, a bit over two weeks, and includes a new hat.
Collect baskets from defeating any monster and open them for event cards, name tags, gems, time candy and hats.
Play Singed cards via the king card in W1 town; main prize cosmic balls are spent in the arcade to boost max level of gold ball shop upgrades by 2 extra.
The jackpot prize is the Singed name tag, which packs a huge damage multiplier.
You earn +1 free event play every day once you collect all 50 daily baskets from mobs.
Name tag isn't displaying in game yet, but is figured to be about 10% W7 kills and 11% bigger damage (later corrected).
Earn free event plays by leaving IdleOn open; the bottom left corner of the event game page shows time to next free play.
Five new collection items in the event shop; talk to Board the cornstalk in W1 town; event points are earned by playing Singed cards.
Dough Roller, first page of event shop, gives 2 extra cooking speed.
Black market (page two, unlocked by clearing page one) has a boat discount making sailing boat upgrades 30% cheaper.
He ranks the boat discount B tier, maybe even lower.
Forbidden Isle page is unlocked after getting everything on black market and has three new upgrades.
Elegant ribbons: new ribbons have 25% chance to be one tier higher; good but weaker than the Bingus pet; unsure it's worth 190 points.
Ladle gives +5 purple and yellow cooking mastery points; purple points aren't needed, yellow nice; unsure it's worth 250.
Fish maxing gives 5x fish and 75% cheaper upgrades for puppy at 275; expensive, maybe best of the bunch if you have multipliers for puppy.
The old upgrade giving 8 weekly exotic market purchases plus percentage is free and still probably the best one; good if you whale.
Everyone gets +16 filter slots, needed while progressing through new maps with Royal Guardian.
Eternal Hunter Pack now gives more filter slots, from 24 to 32.
Orc kills needed to become a Royal Guardian lowered from 600 to 250.
He says 250 kills should be easy now, even at base or about 150 on the old talent level.
W2 sand resources for Royal Guardian had max capacity raised 2x and 5x; he thinks it was necessary.
Resource grades moved from shelf 23 to shelf 22.
Resource grades is arguably the most important Royal Armory upgrade; being hard gated from it matters, and unlocking it gives exponential progress.
If you have silver stopwatches saved for pushing a reset, use them all right before next reset now to unlock resource grades.
Cost of all armory upgrades lowered by 10 to 30%.
The cost cut is not as extreme as the IOS one, which was about 45% or more, but still massive for the progression curve.
Mighty militia upgrades in the Royal Armory now cost W1 cloud resources instead of W2 sand resources.
Total upgrades required to unlock shelf 20 lowered to 44.
Bonus per upgrade of solo militia status lowered from 5 to 4%.
He's happy with the RG changes; they fixed about 80% of his progression curve issues, and he'll see how resource grades feel.
He was holding silver stopwatches before this event and will spend them progressing resource grades.
Fixed timing bug where Deathbringer's Annihilation task often didn't give the full 60 seconds to kill enough mobs.
Fixed incorrect names on the new chat ring guild seasonal rewards.
Fixed Warbound Politics talent giving the bonus of Aesthetics Politics talent; both now do what they say. Fixed a few days ago, now in patch notes.

subsystem: wall of mirrors mc cost reduction
statement: Fixed 80% MC cost reduction for first few upgrades (Wall of Mirrors legend talent) not applying for RG; max level gives about 48 reductions, probably not reachable.
Fixed sushi bonus info display going off screen for the new sushi tiers.
Fixed bug where Royal Guardian's Regal mobs could spawn in funky places.
Fixed resource replenish not giving its percent collection rate; display changed to 1% per level instead of 5%, but it was giving 0%.
Fixed outpost glorification via little Orby shop not granting its 2x rank EXP bonus.
Fixed Hive Mind pet not giving its two Prisma bubbles; applies to previous and future owners.
Singed cards event game gives 2.31 event points per play on average, so 231 per 100 plays; nothing has changed.
Posted odds assume semi-optimal play (higher on low value cards, lower on high); truly optimal play tracking remaining cards can beat the posted odds.
Skeleton keys give 2,200 gold balls on average on the gold ball drop table, mainly due to the huge 64,000 top prize; median is lower.
You are more likely to get Verminous before pity than to hit pity, like previous spectacular pets.
Verminous gives 10,000 gold food bonus and 1.5x gold food bonus multi; the two multiply together.
Many endgame players have over 80,000 gold food bonus; the 10K is a catch-up for non-endgamers, the 1.5x is for endgamers.
Gold food is great: AFK gains, drop rate, EXP, coins; Verminous bonus is obscene.
Correction: the Singed name tag is regular damage percent, not bigger damage; still a decent damage increase.
New Daydreamer pack ($20): rice bag gives 4x EXP summoning, and account bonus +50% winner bonuses from summoning.
He calls the +50% winner bonus disgustingly good and says buying the pack may be necessary.
King of all winners gem shop item in W6: buying the new pack five times gives 1.5x winner bonuses.
The older pack (Valentine's this year) gives more gold food bonus and +5 event plays for every event forever.
At $25 vs $20, the Daydreamer pack is too good given how good endless summoning is.
Endless summoning is one of four mechanics he says hold back the majority of players; the 50% winner bonus is too good.
